system.description:
This jutsu places a flaming seal on a willing creature other than yourself that you touch, creating a chakra connection between you and the target until the jutsu ends. Affected creatures gain a +1 bonus to all saving throws and resistance to Fire damage.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3. If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank, increase the bonus by +1. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, increase the bonus by +2.
